what: Andrew (via coordinator): debug info off the edit path, design docs/v2/plan/design/item-hash.md section 13. Line rows and variable names as a debug record keyed by (code hash, presentation hash); patch identity (patch.rs Mark::of_function lines) leaves them out; the link step writes only a debug map (Apple N_OSO style); the daemon builds records after the edit at low priority or serves them lazily (split DWARF .dwo materialized on open, debuginfod-style by build ID on a user-only socket; lldb debug-map objects on macOS). An edit never waits on them; records byte-identical to a fresh build.
